outcomeContract.technicalPipelinePassDefinition: At least one evaluated route alternative passes routing, geometry, evidence-lineage, access-verification, provenance, containment, and structural-sanity gates. This outcome does not imply product-quality success.
outcomeContract.caseEvaluationPassDefinition: Observed planning state, technicalPipelineOutcome, and productQualityOutcome match the case expectation; every applicable validation rule passes; and no forbidden claim occurs. An expected negative case can therefore pass evaluation by failing or stopping honestly.
